summary: The Bloomfield fire tower in Muskingum County was in use in October 1967 and later removed; firelookout.org lists it relocated to Berg, Holmes County.

facts.status_note: Removed from the Bloomfield site, date not given; firelookout.org lists the tower relocated to Berg, Holmes County, standing

events.note: A local woman was in charge of the tower in October 1967, per a newspaper caption
Registered with FFLOS on September 3, 2014 (US 1555, OH 1)

evidence.supports: helicopter circling the tower to collect a pledge card
evidence.quote: A helicopter circles the Bloomfield fire tower

evidence.supports: woman was in charge of the fire tower
evidence.quote: was in charge of the fire tower

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts page ends with Removed status
Berg tower listed as relocated from Bloomfield, Holmes County, standing

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts ends with Removed (no date) and firelookout.org lists the tower as relocated to Berg, Holmes County. Both can be true: the Bloomfield site is gone and the tower is listed as standing elsewhere.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, builder, design, height or removal date in any source read; the 1967 caption is the only dated evidence of the tower on site. Record elevation 360.9 m matches FFLOS 1,184 ft (361 m). A TopoQuest search snippet labels a Bloomfield tower historical at about 1,154 ft; not read, not used. The Berg relocation rests on the firelookout.org list alone; its date is unverified (a search snippet said 2014). The list gives Berg's coordinates only as Private, so access is unset and the story advises against visiting. No source describes the Bloomfield site today.
